printed: Avenue (name not printed in region; 'AVE.' only)
note: Vermont Ave (50', west face ~5270, east face ~5350, 6in pipe line ~5297) ends at its south end on an E-W avenue labelled only 'AVE.' (60' marked; north face = block line ~3157, south line ~3250, 6in pipe line at ~3200). Taken as Stock Avenue by position (matches plate 22-38). Stock Ave ends just east at the old canal bed, so it is effectively an L/T corner. Name 'Stock' not printed within region.

Vermont Ave (50', 537-614, pipe line at ~565) meets Stock Ave (60', 6341 to ~6430, pipe line at ~6392) at Vermont's south end; Stock runs west, both end at the canal bed diagonal to the east, so it is an L-shaped corner. Point lies at/just past the canal-bed boundary diagonal; surrounding area masked white.

Vermont Ave (west face ~5275, east ~5350) ends at its north end on a narrow E-W alley (north line ~2372, south line ~2398) printed only 'ALLEY'; taken as Bates Alley by position (matches plate 22-38). Alley continues east toward the canal. A second unnamed alley at y~2800 inside the Cormany-Vermont block is not Bates.
Bates Alley (~15 px wide, north line ~5586, south ~5601, slight slope) runs E-W; Vermont Ave (531-610) ends at it from the south. Area north of the alley is masked white.

N-S avenue (60') labelled only 'AVENUE', taken as West McMicken Avenue: west face ~1120, east face (Riddle estate corner) ~1222; a 6in pipe line runs inside it at ~1155 and turns east along Dixmyth at y~1108. Dixmyth (55') runs east from it: south face ~1175, north face ~1085 at the white mask edge. Dixmyth ends at the avenue (T). Alternative reading if the 1155/1108 lines were street faces would be ~ (1190, 1142).
